visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of several black Chanel gift boxes stacked on a dark wooden table in a well-lit indoor space. Each box is wrapped with a textured black-and-white tweed ribbon featuring a centered gold button. An abstract painting hangs on the cream-colored wall in the background, next to black paper shopping bags. White Traditional Chinese subtitles are centered at the bottom of the frame. (2) A pair of hands with manicured nails and multiple rings enters the frame to untie a small black box. Upon opening it, the hands showcase a set of gold earrings featuring letters that spell out the brand name. The camera stays in a medium close-up, focusing on the intricate details of the jewelry as the hands turn the box. Subtitles continue to cycle through describing the items. (3) The scene cuts to a long, slim box being opened by the same hands. A split-screen briefly appears, showing a celebrity in a photo wearing similar black leather gloves. The hands pull out a pair of black leather gloves, demonstrating the soft texture and the small logos visible on each fingertip. White captions overlay the visual comparison and description. (4) A large gift box is opened, revealing several layers of crisp white branded tissue paper. The hands carefully pull out a white and gold tweed handbag with a metallic chain strap. The camera zooms in to capture the shimmering sequins and gold threads woven into the fabric. Technical details about the bag's size appear as text overlays at the bottom. (5) The final segment shows a festive Christmas card and then the opening of another box containing a gold necklace with a deer-shaped pendant. The person displays all the loose gold buttons and unboxed jewelry items together on the table for a final summary shot. A call-to-action text with a heart emoji appears on the screen as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-pitched, enthusiastic female narration in Traditional Chinese, set against a medium-tempo acoustic pop background track featuring a bright piano melody and a steady, light drum beat. The voice is clear and professional, exhibiting high emotional arousal and a friendly, welcoming tone that sets a celebratory mood for the unboxing. (2) As the first box is handled, the sound of paper rustling and the soft thud of the box being placed on the table are clearly audible. The narrator’s speech rate remains moderate and expressive. A subtle 'ding' sound effect is added during the reveal of the letter earrings, emphasizing the visual highlight while the background music continues smoothly. (3) The sound of crisp tissue paper being unfolded becomes more prominent as the leather gloves are removed. The narrator’s voice exhibits breathy qualities and an excited pitch contour as she references a celebrity. The background music maintains its upbeat major-mode tonality, providing a consistent acoustic floor underneath the various incidental handling noises. (4) During the unboxing of the tweed handbag, there is a dense layer of rustling sounds as the large amount of protective paper is moved. The narrator’s voice swells in intensity, reflecting high valence and joy. The percussive elements of the background music are well-balanced with the vocal track, ensuring the narration remains the primary signal throughout. (5) In the final phase, the audio captures the light metallic clinking of the jewelry and necklace against the table. The narrator’s tone becomes more reflective and informative, explaining the symbolic meaning of the deer pendant. The video ends with a concluding statement and a slight fade in both the vocal volume and the background music track.
